mapper.sql: id, stat_id, stat_period, stat_date, year, month, week, emotion, count, ratio, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hm_emotion_stats ( stat_id, stat_period, stat_date, year, month, week, emotion, count, ratio, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{statId}, #{statPeriod}, #{statDate}, #{year}, #{month}, #{week}, #{emotion}, #{count}, #{ratio}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE hm_emotion_stats SET count = #{count}, ratio = #{ratio}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(timestamp) AS stat_date, emotion, COUNT(*) AS count FROM hm_hug_record WHERE timestamp >= #{startDate} AND timestamp < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND emotion IS NOT NULL AND emotion != '' GROUP BY DATE(timestamp), emotion ORDER BY stat_date ASC, count DESC

SELECT YEAR(timestamp) AS year, WEEK(timestamp, 3) AS week, DATE(DATE_SUB(timestamp, INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(timestamp) - 2) DAY)) AS stat_date, emotion, COUNT(*) AS count FROM hm_hug_record WHERE timestamp >= #{startDate} AND timestamp < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND emotion IS NOT NULL AND emotion != '' GROUP BY YEAR(timestamp), WEEK(timestamp, 3), emotion ORDER BY stat_date ASC, count DESC

SELECT YEAR(timestamp) AS year, MONTH(timestamp) AS month, DATE(DATE_FORMAT(timestamp, '%Y-%m-01')) AS stat_date, emotion, COUNT(*) AS count FROM hm_hug_record WHERE timestamp >= #{startDate} AND timestamp < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND emotion IS NOT NULL AND emotion != '' GROUP BY YEAR(timestamp), MONTH(timestamp), emotion ORDER BY stat_date ASC, count DESC
